note: WORKSPACE_GENERATED_COPY_V97 in app/app.js is a GENERATED table: it was machine-translated in
one pass at v97 and, until nestly_v465, had no generator in the repo, so the only way to add a
string was to hand-edit 1472 entries of frozen JSON. Exactly one entry ('/month') had been added
that way, and it shows: it sits alone past the end of the sort order. v461's author declined to
hand-patch three more and said the generator's owner should add them; this file plus that script
IS the generator, and this is where the three strings go.
Every entry here is applied on every run and the run is idempotent, so this doubles as the
reviewed ledger of every source string added to the generated table since v97.
Curated overrides for critical labels still belong in WORKSPACE_COPY_V97, which wins over this
table at lookup time (curated ?? generated ?? source).

entries.source: Stamps

entries.source: Ask an owner to review your Customers and Record sale assignments.
entries.reason: nestly_v928 — the Record sale screen, whole. This is the screen front-line staff live in, and the one the UX plan writes for: team members who may read little English. It was still almost entirely English under a Chinese workspace. Translated in one pass so no half of a bill reads in one language and the other half in another. Three reachability classes are covered, not one: literal text nodes, ternaries that form a WHOLE text node, and toast() messages — toast runs its own argument through workspaceTranslationV97, so a toast is reachable by this same table even though it is never a text node. Nothing interpolated was added: a string the flat table cannot match would ship as finished work and never render. 'Peekaa' is never translated.
